metadata.query: Why did Dylann Roof kill people in the Charleston church shooting?

final_answer: Dylann Roof, the perpetrator of the Charleston church shooting, killed nine African Americans during a Bible study at Emanuel African Methodist Episcopal Church in Charleston, South Carolina, on June 17, 2015. His motive for the attack was to start a race war, according to a manifesto he wrote and posted online before the shooting. [Sources: History.com Editors (2019, June 17). Dylann Roof. A&E Television Networks. Retrieved June 17, 2019, from https://www.history.com/news/dylann-roof-charleston-church-shooting; Associated Press. (2015, June 18). Charleston church shooting: What we know about the suspect. The Washington Post. Retrieved June 18, 2015, from https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/06/18/charleston-church-shooting-what-we-know-about-the-suspect/]
